Classic wood grain design prefabricated container house
The Classic wood grain design prefabricated container house is a modern and cozy living space with a timeless wooden aesthetic. It offers a convenient and sustainable housing solution, combining the durability of container construction with the charm of a rustic wooden finish.
2023 11 08
Special custom camouflage/Army green container houses for outdoor, military use
Our special custom camouflage/army green container houses designed exclusively for military purposes in outdoor settings. These uniquely crafted containers offer efficient and secure accommodations for military personnel, blending seamlessly with the natural environment while ensuring optimum functionality.
2023 11 08

2023 11 07

Customizable 20ft, 30ft, 40ft XL expandable container house
Step into the world of limitless possibilities with our Customizable XL Expandable Container House. Picture this: you stroll through a picturesque seaside town and stumble upon a stunning 20ft container house, exuding luxury and style. As you explore further, you uncover the full majesty of a 40ft haven, with customizable features that cater to your every desire. Embrace the freedom to personalize your dream abode.
2023 11 05
The new Z-type folding packaging container series - breaks the short board of the traditional waist folding container
Introducing the revolutionary Z-type folding packaging container series that improves upon the limitations of traditional waist folding containers. Designed to break the mould, this innovative packaging offers enhanced usability and practicality. Perfect for industries like logistics, retail, and e-commerce, it can be utilized for efficient transportation, storage, and organization of goods, ensuring hassle-free operations and maximum convenience for users.
2023 11 04
Customisable double wing container houses are popular with New Zealand customers
The custom double wing container house from New Zealand is a unique and innovative architectural concept that combines the industrial charm of shipping containers with a modern, comfortable living space. It offers a flexible design, showcasing New Zealand's creativity and sustainability in housing solutions.
2023 11 04
The foldable extension container house is the most popular container board house in 2023
The foldable extension container house has become widely popular in 2023 due to its versatility and convenience. This innovative housing solution provides users with the ability to easily extend the living space when needed, making it perfect for various scenarios such as temporary accommodations, disaster relief, or even as a backyard studio. Its foldable design allows for quick and hassle-free setup, offering users a flexible and adaptable living environment.
2023 11 03
Custom containers for feeding sika deer
The Sika deer on the island were raised in container houses, providing a unique and controlled environment for their well-being. This innovative approach allows for easy management and monitoring of the deer population, making it useful for conservation efforts, research purposes, and even eco-tourism initiatives. The container houses could also potentially be utilized in other areas with similar wildlife management needs, serving as temporary shelters or breeding facilities.
2023 11 03
Containerized Garden: Transform Your Outdoor Space with a Sustainable Garden House
The "Outdoor garden house made from container house" is a unique and eco-friendly living space created by repurposing shipping containers. It features a beautiful outdoor garden that seamlessly blends nature with modern architecture.
2023 11 02
The client is undertaking a power station project in Africa and can benefit from utilizing our container storage facilities
Our client, who is currently engaged in a power station project in Africa, stands to gain significant advantages by utilizing our container storage facilities. These facilities offer convenient and secure storage solutions tailored to their specific project requirements.
